free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source TCP/UDP tunnel over HTTP with SSH encryption, reverse port forwarding and SOCKS5 support; no vendor-imposed tunnel, user or traffic quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: Requires your own reachable server, bandwidth and networking; VPS and egress may cost money. Configure authentication, server fingerprint validation and access controls before exposing services. Free software is not a free hosted relay.

name: GOST Simple Tunnel Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source GO Simple Tunnel proxy and tunneling software supporting TCP/UDP port forwarding, reverse tunnels, multi-hop forwarding, SOCKS and HTTP proxies; no vendor-imposed connection or bandwidth quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: You supply and pay for servers, networking and bandwidth. Configure authentication, TLS, firewall rules and access controls; do not expose an unrestricted public proxy. No managed free relay is included.

name: Knot Resolver Self-Hosted
free_limit: GPL-licensed open-source caching, DNSSEC-validating recursive DNS resolver with modular policy and DNS privacy support; no vendor-imposed DNS-query, zone, or client quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: Requires your own server, network bandwidth, security updates and correct resolver access controls. Avoid exposing an unrestricted public recursive resolver. GPL redistribution obligations apply; managed DNS hosting is not included.

name: sish SSH Tunnel Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source SSH tunneling server for HTTP(S), WebSockets and TCP forwarding with public/private aliases and SNI routing; no vendor-imposed tunnel or traffic quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires a reachable server, DNS, SSH keys and optionally TLS certificates; compute, domains and bandwidth are not free. The separately offered managed tuns.sh service has its own terms and is not included.

name: Pi-hole DNS Sinkhole Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free EUPL-licensed self-hosted DNS sinkhole for network-wide ad and tracker blocking, local DNS caching and optional DHCP; no vendor-imposed DNS-query or client quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Linux/Docker host and DNS configuration, upkeep and blocklist management. Avoid exposing an open public resolver; DNS filtering can break legitimate sites. EUPL license conditions apply; hosting and bandwidth are not included.

name: YADIFA Authoritative DNS Self-Hosted
free_limit: BSD 3-Clause licensed authoritative DNS name server with DNSSEC and dynamic DNS updates; free to download and self-host with no software licensing fee or vendor-imposed zone/query allowance.
watch_out: Authoritative DNS software, not free managed DNS hosting or a general recursive resolver. Requires servers, redundant nameservers, public connectivity, maintenance and DNSSEC key management; infrastructure costs are separate.

name: OpenReplay Open-Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free AGPLv3-licensed self-hosted edition for low-traffic session replay, developer tools, product analytics and co-browsing; recordings and storage run on your own infrastructure, without a hosted free-usage credit.
watch_out: Requires your own infrastructure (official starting guide suggests at least 2 vCPUs, 8 GB RAM and 50 GB disk), privacy consent and sensitive-data masking. AGPL source-sharing obligations may apply; paid Dedicated and Enterprise capabilities are separate.

name: werf Kubernetes CI/CD (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source CLI for building, publishing, testing and deploying container applications to Kubernetes with Git, Buildah and Helm; self-managed use without a werf license fee.
watch_out: Requires your own CI runner, container registry and Kubernetes cluster; compute, registry storage, bandwidth and other infrastructure are not included. This is not a free hosted CI service.

name: Sim AI Workspace (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted AI agent and workflow builder with integrations, run logs and knowledge resources; run the software on your own infrastructure without a Sim Cloud subscription.
watch_out: Self-hosted production Docker Compose stack requires substantial RAM (project setup guidance notes 12 GB or more) and local secrets. Model API, hosting, storage and third-party integrations may incur fees; Sim Cloud is separate.

name: Jenkins X (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes-native CI/CD with Tekton pipelines and pull-request preview environments; self-managed software without a Jenkins X license fee.
watch_out: Requires Kubernetes, Git hosting, container registry and compatible pipeline infrastructure; cloud resources and associated usage can cost money. Distinct from Jenkins OSS and Tekton itself.

name: Devtron Platform (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source self-hosted Kubernetes dashboard and CI/CD platform supporting Helm and GitOps-based deployments; no license fee for the open-source code.
watch_out: Needs a Kubernetes cluster and Helm; compute, storage, monitoring and optional integrations may incur costs. Devtron SaaS and commercial offerings are separate.

name: Coze Studio (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source platform to build and deploy AI agents, workflows, plugins and knowledge bases on your own infrastructure using Docker Compose; no Coze Studio software license fee.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires at least 2 CPU cores, 4 GB RAM and Docker Compose. LLM API usage, hosting, databases and integrations can incur charges; Coze's managed platform is separate.

name: Pocket ID Self-Hosted
free_limit: BSD-2-Clause self-hosted OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 identity provider with passkey-only sign-in; no vendor-imposed user or login quota.
watch_out: Passkeys are required (no password fallback); deploy and secure your own server, HTTPS, backups and identity configuration. Hosting costs are not included.

name: Kanidm Identity Management Self-Hosted
free_limit: MPL-2.0 self-hosted identity management with OAuth2/OIDC SSO, passkeys, LDAP gateway and Unix integration; no vendor-imposed user quota.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires your own infrastructure and operational security; LDAP gateway is read-only, and deployment/replication require configuration. MPL-2.0 obligations apply.

name: UrBackup Self-Hosted Server
free_limit: AGPLv3+ open-source client/server file and image backups with incremental backups and a web admin UI; no vendor-imposed device or storage quota.
watch_out: Your server, disks and network capacity determine practical limits; configure backup retention and restore testing. AGPLv3+ obligations apply to modified network-served software.

name: Smallstep step-ca Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted private X.509 and SSH certificate authority with ACME issuance and automated renewal; no vendor-imposed certificate quota.
watch_out: Free open-source CA lacks several commercial Smallstep features, including turnkey multi-CA, high-availability and enterprise support; manage private keys and infrastructure yourself.

name: OpenCloud Self-Hosted File Platform
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted file sync, sharing and collaboration platform with filesystem-backed storage; no vendor-imposed storage quota in the open-source server.

free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source encrypted incremental and compressed backups to S3, SFTP, WebDAV and cloud storage providers; no software backup-volume quota.

name: llama.cpp Self-Hosted LLM Inference
free_limit: MIT-licensed local LLM inference engine and OpenAI-compatible llama-server with no software-enforced request quota; runs on your own CPU/GPU hardware.

name: Tuzzle Hobby Free Media CDN
free_limit: 30,000 image transformations/month; 20 GB bandwidth and 10 GB media storage; WebP/AVIF and URL-based transforms
watch_out: Hobby is positioned for side projects; advanced video/audio/document features, signed URLs and smart cropping require paid plans. Overage may be billed unless hard caps are configured; commercial-use terms unconfirmed.

name: statichost.eu Hobby Free Static Hosting
free_limit: 1 static site, 10 GB bandwidth and 100 build minutes; custom domain, automatic HTTPS, private Git repositories and deployment webhooks
watch_out: Free Hobby builds use a queue rather than immediate scheduling; hosting and build quotas are limited. Provider states no trial period and no credit card, but commercial-use terms and overage behavior require confirmation.

name: Stow Free Media Library
free_limit: 500 assets, 1 GB storage, 10,000 API requests/day, 2 applications; shared content-addressed media library
watch_out: Free plan is positioned for side projects/experimentation; AI processing and larger limits require Pro. Media library is hosted by Stow; commercial-use terms are not explicit.

name: Google Cloud Scheduler Free Allowance
free_limit: 3 scheduled jobs free per Google Cloud billing account each month; individual job executions are not billed by Cloud Scheduler
watch_out: Billing account required; free allowance is shared across projects and paused jobs count. Each additional job costs $0.10 per 31 days, and target services may bill separately.

name: SheetDB Free Google Sheets REST API
free_limit: 2 spreadsheet APIs and 500 API requests/month; CORS origin restrictions, IP allowlist and response caching
watch_out: Google Sheets permissions and limits apply separately. Requests above the free quota return HTTP 429; IP rate limit is 30 requests per 10 seconds. Commercial-use terms are not explicitly confirmed.

name: Gedo Free Authoritative DNS
free_limit: Unlimited DNS zones, records and queries with DNSSEC, IPv4/IPv6, REST API, dynamic DNS, primary/secondary zones and TSIG transfers
watch_out: Authoritative DNS hosting only; domain registration and any website infrastructure are separate. Provider offers email support without a paid SLA; commercial and small-business use is supported.

name: Nubbo Free Cloud Storage Manager
free_limit: Connect 2 S3-compatible storage providers; 3 galleries and 3 file requests; unlimited shares and encrypted provider credentials
watch_out: Nubbo manages third-party storage and does NOT include storage capacity or bandwidth; your S3 provider may charge separately. Public API and advanced features are planned for paid plans; card and commercial terms unconfirmed.

name: Goose Open-Source Local AI Agent
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source desktop/CLI/API agent with local execution, MCP extensions, skills and configurable LLM providers
watch_out: Agent software is free; paid LLM APIs/subscriptions and local hardware are not included. Choose an available local model for no provider usage charges; review model licenses separately.

name: Azure Pipelines Free Parallel Jobs
free_limit: 1 Microsoft-hosted parallel CI/CD job with up to 1,800 minutes/month for private projects; 1 self-hosted parallel job with unlimited minutes
watch_out: The free parallel-job grant requires Azure DevOps organization billing linked to a valid Azure subscription; hosted jobs have a 60-minute run limit. New public projects are retired, and additional capacity is paid. Azure subscription/payment-method requirements vary.

name: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler Free Tier
free_limit: 14,000,000 scheduled invocations/month free across eligible AWS regions, supporting cron, rate-based and one-time schedules
watch_out: AWS account and billing setup required; invocations above free allowance cost $1 per million. Downstream target services, data transfer and related AWS resources may incur separate charges; GovCloud excluded.

name: EmailJS Free Email API
free_limit: 200 email API requests/month; 2 templates, 1 user seat, 500 contacts and 7-day email history
watch_out: Free tier is positioned for testing and small projects; requests over monthly limit are dropped. No attachments or custom domain whitelist on Free; commercial-use terms require confirmation.

name: Formcarry Baby Free Form Backend
free_limit: 1 hosted form and 50 submissions/month with email notifications, spam filtering and form API
watch_out: Submissions above the free limit are held but inaccessible until upgrade; paid plans provide more forms, quota and integrations. Free plan is for small projects or businesses; payment method not explicitly confirmed.

name: Fermyon Cloud Starter Free
free_limit: Up to 5 serverless WebAssembly Spin apps, 100,000 requests/month, 1 GB key-value storage, 1 GB SQLite storage and 5 GB bandwidth
watch_out: Requires WebAssembly/Spin deployment; Starter is an ongoing open-beta free tier with no SLA. Paid Growth raises limits; custom domains may require paid tier and card/commercial terms are not explicitly confirmed.

name: Dagu Community Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free GPL-3.0 self-hosted workflow scheduler/orchestrator with YAML DAGs, cron scheduling, retries, run history and a built-in web UI; Community server needs no license key or per-run subscription.
watch_out: Operate your own server, workers, storage and networking; hosting and external APIs cost extra. Paid self-host licensing adds SSO, RBAC and audit features. GPL-3.0 obligations and separate commercial embedding terms may apply.

name: Cronicle Open Source Scheduler
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted distributed job scheduler and runner with web UI, multi-server scheduling, cron-style repeating/on-demand jobs, logs and REST API; no software license fee or vendor job quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Node.js hosts, storage and operations; infrastructure costs are not included. Maintainers now focus new features on successor xyOps; Cronicle receives primarily maintenance and security fixes.

name: Webhook.site Open Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook and HTTP request inspection server, with unique test URLs and realtime request viewing; no vendor-imposed request quota for the open-source edition.
watch_out: Run your own Docker/PHP hosting, storage, TLS and networking; infrastructure costs are separate. Open-source edition does not include cloud/Pro-only Custom Actions and other paid features; configure access controls and retention before exposing captured payloads.

name: webhookd Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted HTTP webhook server that triggers local shell scripts/processes, supports signed requests, TLS and Docker or Go deployment; no vendor-imposed event or endpoint quota.
watch_out: Runs local commands in response to HTTP requests: enforce request signatures, network restrictions and least privilege. Requires your own server, TLS, monitoring and operational security; compute and networking costs are separate. Not a hosted managed webhook delivery tier.

name: Nitric Open-Source Backend Framework
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source backend/serverless framework with APIs, functions, resource declarations, local development and deployment providers for AWS, Azure, GCP or user-managed infrastructure; no vendor license or per-function fee for the framework.
watch_out: Nitric is developer software, not a free hosted compute allowance. Deployed functions, databases, buckets, networks and cloud provider resources incur their own costs; a cloud account may require billing details. Plugin/provider compatibility and runtime quotas depend on the selected infrastructure.

name: code-server (Self-Hosted VS Code)
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source code-server runs a browser-accessible VS Code environment on your own Linux machine or server, with no software license fee or published usage quota for the self-hosted edition.
watch_out: You supply and pay for compute, storage, networking, HTTPS and maintenance; code-server recommends at least 1 GB RAM and 2 vCPUs. This is not a free managed cloud workspace; secure remote access before exposing it publicly.

name: Zenko CloudServer (Self-Hosted S3 API)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source S3-compatible Node.js server for local/on-premises object storage and development/testing; no license fee or vendor-enforced object quota for self-hosted use.
watch_out: This is software, not a free hosted S3 bucket. You provide disks, compute, backups and security; external cloud storage backends can incur charges. The upstream README documents example default access keys that must be replaced for real deployments.

name: DevPod Open Source (Local Development Environments)
free_limit: Free MPL-2.0 client-only desktop/CLI tool to create devcontainer-based development environments on local Docker or user-selected remote infrastructure; no DevPod software subscription or usage quota for the open-source client.
watch_out: DevPod is not a free cloud hosting provider: cloud VMs, Kubernetes clusters, remote hosts and container resources may incur third-party charges. MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft conditions apply to modified source files; local Docker must be provided separately.

name: Pydio Cells Home (Self-Hosted File Sharing)
free_limit: Official free Cells Home edition for self-hosted file sharing with filesystem/S3-compatible storage, document previews, sharing, WebDAV, REST API and desktop/mobile sync; no published expiration for the Home edition.
watch_out: Free Home tier is marketed for home use and evaluation; suitability for production business use should be confirmed. Paid Connect/Enterprise add SSO, LDAP, compliance and support. Hosting, storage and backups are user-funded; AGPLv3 source-sharing obligations may apply.

name: ZAP (Open Source Web Security Scanner)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 web application security scanner with free local desktop, daemon and automated scans; no per-scan software fee.
watch_out: Only scan targets you own or are authorized to assess; active scans can disrupt applications. Local hardware and any commercial support are not included.

name: Open Interpreter (Open Source Agent)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 local coding agent with CLI, model-provider selection and sandboxed command execution; no software subscription fee.
watch_out: Hosted AI model providers may charge separately; agent-generated commands require careful permissions and approvals. Current Rust project differs from the older Python edition.

name: Grype (Anchore Open Source)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 CLI vulnerability scanning of container images, filesystems and SBOMs with no per-scan software license fee.
watch_out: Vulnerability database and target downloads need network access; findings depend on database freshness. Anchore Enterprise and commercial support are separate paid offerings.

name: TelemetryDeck Free Analytics
free_limit: 50,000 analytics events per month free for accounts created on or after July 1, 2026; older free accounts retain 100,000 events/month.
watch_out: Usage above the allowance can stop ingestion; TelemetryDeck describes automatic subscription upgrades after repeated overages, so check billing controls and current dashboard terms. Paid features and higher event volumes cost extra.

name: MiniSearch (Local Full-Text Search)
free_limit: MIT-licensed JavaScript full-text search library for browser and Node.js; local in-memory indexing, fuzzy and prefix search, with no vendor usage quota.
watch_out: Local/embedded library, not a hosted search service. Index data must fit available application memory; CPU, storage, hosting and maintenance are your responsibility.

name: GoogieHost Free Web Hosting
free_limit: Free-forever managed hosting for 1 website with 1,000 MB NVMe storage, SSL, a free subdomain, one MySQL database, one email account and FTP access.
watch_out: Shared hosting subject to provider terms and resource limits; provider may suspend accounts that do not respond to notifications for an extended period. Domain registration is separate; commercial-use eligibility is not explicitly confirmed.

name: Togglely Open-Source Feature Flags
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted feature-flag management with targeting, environments, organizations, audit logs and Docker Compose deployment; no software usage quota stated.
watch_out: Self-hosted open-source edition; server, database, security, backups and operations are not provided free. Hosted Togglely service has separate terms and is not included.

name: Parca Open-Source Continuous Profiling
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source continuous CPU and memory profiling with self-hosted Parca server, web UI and eBPF agent; no vendor-enforced profiling quota for the self-managed edition.
watch_out: Requires your own compute, storage, network security, Kubernetes or Linux host setup, and operations. eBPF profiling needs compatible Linux kernel and permissions. Managed profiling, infrastructure, and optional third-party services may cost extra; not a free hosted cloud plan.

name: Kener Open-Source Status Pages
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted status pages with service monitoring, incidents, maintenance notices and public status communication; no vendor-enforced site or monitor quota for the open-source edition.
watch_out: You must deploy and maintain the Node.js/Svelte application, database, Redis/cache where required, HTTPS, backups and monitoring. Email, SMS, infrastructure and third-party integrations may incur separate charges; no managed service SLA is included.

name: JetBrains TeamCity Professional (On-Premises Free)
free_limit: Free-forever on-premises Professional CI/CD server with unlimited users, 3 build agents, up to 100 build configurations and 10 pipelines; no recurring TeamCity server license fee within those limits.
watch_out: Self-hosted server and build-agent infrastructure are not included. Extra agents and Enterprise features cost money; TeamCity Cloud has no ongoing free tier (trial only). The free edition's build configuration and pipeline limits still apply.

name: SQLite Embedded SQL Database
free_limit: Public-domain, in-process SQL database engine for local applications with no vendor subscription, seat limit, database-size quota imposed by a hosted plan, or per-query charge for the core library.
watch_out: Runs embedded in the application rather than as a managed multi-user database server. Local disk, memory, backup, concurrency and hosting limits still apply; optional commercial SQLite extensions, support and warranty-of-title are separately priced.

name: PGlite Embedded PostgreSQL (WASM)
free_limit: Open-source Apache-2.0/PostgreSQL-licensed PostgreSQL-compatible WebAssembly database for browser, Node.js, Bun and Deno; in-memory or local filesystem/IndexedDB persistence with no vendor-enforced local query quota.
watch_out: Embedded single-user/local database, not a managed cloud PostgreSQL service or drop-in multi-client server. Storage, browser resource limits, sync services, and remote hosting are separate; some integrations may have their own costs.

name: OpenVPN Community Open-Source VPN
free_limit: GPL-2.0 open-source VPN daemon and community server/client software with no vendor-imposed connection or seat quota for self-managed deployments.
watch_out: Users must supply and secure their own VPN host, network bandwidth, TLS keys, updates, routing and client configurations. GPL-2.0 obligations apply to redistribution; commercial OpenVPN Access Server features, support and hosting are separate paid offerings.

name: Hugging Face Transformers Open Source Library
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Python model-definition library for local inference and training across text, image, audio and multimodal models; no library subscription or per-inference vendor charge.
watch_out: Model weights and datasets have their own licenses, access gates and commercial restrictions; check each model separately. Local CPU/GPU, storage, cloud hosting and optional paid model/API endpoints are not included.

name: Carrd Basic Free
free_limit: Up to 3 responsive one-page sites per account on Carrd subdomains with core site-building features.
watch_out: Free Basic sites retain Carrd branding; custom domains, forms, embeds and analytics require paid Pro. Commercial-use restrictions for the Basic offering are not independently confirmed; check the current terms.

name: Huey Open Source Task Queue
free_limit: MIT-licensed Python task queue with scheduling, retries and Redis, PostgreSQL, SQLite, file or in-memory backends; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Self-managed worker processes and optional Redis/PostgreSQL brokers are not hosted for free; production operation, monitoring and infrastructure costs remain your responsibility.

name: Fail2Ban Open Source
free_limit: GPL-2.0 licensed daemon to ban repeated authentication failures using log-based filters; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires a compatible self-managed host, log access and firewall integration; server costs and ongoing security administration are not included. GPL redistribution obligations apply.

name: FlexSearch Open Source
free_limit: Apache-2.0 JavaScript full-text search library for browsers and Node.js; no library usage quota.
watch_out: The free Apache-2.0 library runs in your own browser or Node.js application; server-side deployment and optional persistent database connectors incur separate infrastructure or database costs.

name: Upptime GitHub Actions Uptime Monitor
free_limit: MIT-licensed uptime monitoring and public status page using your GitHub repository: scheduled endpoint checks, incident Issues, history commits and GitHub Pages; no Upptime subscription or dedicated monitoring server.
watch_out: You must configure and maintain a GitHub repository and workflows. GitHub Actions minutes, API/rate limits, repository visibility and GitHub Pages eligibility depend on your GitHub plan; private-repository workflows or excess usage can incur charges. Public monitoring history may expose endpoint details.

name: Statping-ng Self-Hosted Status Monitor
free_limit: GPL-3.0 open-source uptime and status-page server with HTTP/TCP/UDP/ICMP/gRPC monitoring, status graphs and notification integrations; no software subscription or monitored-endpoint quota.
watch_out: Self-managed deployment, database, TLS, backups and server resources are not included; SMS or other third-party alerting services may charge. GPL-3.0 obligations apply when distributing modified software; this is the statping-ng fork, not a hosted free plan.

name: GoReleaser OSS
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed GoReleaser OSS command-line release automation for building, packaging and publishing Go project releases on local machines or existing CI runners.
watch_out: GoReleaser Pro premium features are not included. GitHub Actions or other CI minutes, package registries, signing, cloud resources and third-party release services can cost extra; this entry covers the OSS CLI only.

name: Spin Open-Source WebAssembly Serverless Framework
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Spin CLI and runtime to build and run WebAssembly serverless applications locally or on self-managed infrastructure; no software subscription, app count or invocation quota in the open-source runtime.
watch_out: Spin OSS is not a free managed cloud deployment. Running production apps requires your own infrastructure and operational work; Fermyon Cloud and other providers have separate plans and usage limits. Language toolchains, databases, registries and cloud resources may cost extra. Distinct from SpinKube and Fermyon Cloud Starter.

name: H2 Database Engine
free_limit: Free Java SQL database engine (MPL 2.0 or EPL 1.0) with embedded, in-memory and TCP server modes; no software-enforced storage or query quota.
watch_out: Runs inside your JVM or on infrastructure you operate; hosting, storage and operations are not included. Modified H2 source must meet license publication obligations; distributed binaries need license and disclaimer notices.

name: wstunnel
free_limit: BSD-3-Clause open-source WebSocket, HTTP/2 and WebTransport tunnel client/server; no software-imposed tunnel or bandwidth quota.
watch_out: Requires your own reachable server and bandwidth; infrastructure and data transfer may cost money. Not a privacy tool: use trusted TLS and protect tunneled traffic end to end. Embedded self-signed certificate is unsuitable for production trust; WebTransport additionally requires reachable UDP.

name: WebHook Tester (tarampampam)
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook inspection and testing app with unique request URLs, configurable responses and WebSocket live updates; no vendor request quota.
watch_out: Requires your own host and network access; hosting and optional ngrok tunneling may cost money. In-memory storage loses captured requests on restart; configure filesystem or Redis for persistence and Redis for multi-instance deployments.

name: sshuttle
free_limit: Free LGPL-2.1 open-source transparent proxy over SSH for routed TCP and DNS traffic; no software-enforced traffic quota.
watch_out: Requires your own reachable SSH server and Python 3.10+ on both ends, plus sudo/root access on the client. Remote server or network transfer may cost money; UDP support depends on the local firewall method and Windows support is experimental.

name: Google Gemini CLI (Free Individual)
free_limit: Open-source terminal AI agent; personal Google-account free access currently lists up to 1,000 model requests per user per day (capacity limits apply).
watch_out: Free access is for eligible individual Google accounts and may be restricted to Flash models; commercial eligibility for the free account must be checked. Paid API keys, Vertex AI billing, and higher tiers are separate.

name: Microsoft inshellisense (Open Source)
free_limit: MIT-licensed terminal-native autocomplete for 600+ command-line tools; free local installation via npm or Homebrew.
watch_out: Runs locally on Windows, Linux and macOS; no managed hosting or bundled cloud service is included. Shell setup and local tooling are required.

name: SillyTavern Open-Source AI Interface
free_limit: AGPL-3.0 licensed local AI chat frontend with no software subscription or fixed usage quota.
watch_out: Does not provide hosted AI inference or model credits; paid model APIs and local GPU/server resources are separate. AGPL obligations apply when modifying or distributing the software.

name: Restfox Open-Source API Client
free_limit: MIT-licensed offline-first HTTP, GraphQL and WebSocket testing client; free desktop builds and self-run web edition.
watch_out: The browser/web edition requires your own runtime or server; external APIs and hosting may charge separately. No vendor-operated hosted free tier is included.

name: Filen Free Encrypted Cloud Storage
free_limit: 10 GB zero-knowledge encrypted cloud storage granted at signup to eligible new accounts; free allocation remains available after signup.
watch_out: Free 10 GB is a one-time eligibility-checked signup grant: VPN/proxy or anonymization-network signups may receive no free storage, with no later manual grant. Business use and card requirements need confirmation.

name: Unsloth Open-Source Local AI Training
free_limit: Free local LLM inference and fine-tuning with Apache-2.0 core; Unsloth Studio components are AGPL-3.0, with no bundled paid GPU or hosted compute.
watch_out: Local training/inference needs compatible hardware, GPU memory and model weights; cloud GPUs, hosted inference and third-party model APIs may charge separately. AGPL-3.0 Studio and model-license obligations apply.

name: acme-dns Open-Source ACME Challenge DNS
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted DNS server and HTTPS API for automated ACME DNS-01 TXT challenges; supports SQLite or PostgreSQL backends.
watch_out: Requires your own DNS-capable server, port 53, domain NS/CNAME delegation and HTTPS API security; hosting, domains and any external CA/service costs are not included. Not a general managed DNS free plan.

name: MaraDNS Open-Source DNS Server
free_limit: BSD-2-Clause open-source authoritative DNS server with Deadwood recursive resolver; no software subscription, zone or query billing.
watch_out: Requires self-managed DNS infrastructure, domain delegation, security updates and monitoring. Hosting and network costs are separate; no managed DNS service or uptime SLA is included.

name: DNSCrypt dnscrypt-proxy (Open Source)
free_limit: ISC-licensed local DNS proxy with DNSCrypt v2, DNS-over-HTTPS, anonymized DNS, caching, DNS filtering and multi-platform binaries.
watch_out: Runs on your own device/router or server; requires a chosen upstream resolver and careful network configuration. Free software does not include a managed DNS service, hosting or paid resolver charges.

name: Kipstats Free Web Analytics
free_limit: Free forever for 1 website and up to 10,000 pageviews per month; includes friction detection, custom events, funnels, REST API and CSV export.
watch_out: When monthly pageviews exceed 10,000, collection pauses until the next month or upgrade; existing data remains. Free plan is marketed for personal sites/early projects; commercial eligibility is not explicit. EU-hosted, no self-hosted edition.

name: OpenMeter Open-Source Usage Metering
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source metering and billing infrastructure for usage events, real-time aggregation, entitlements, pricing and usage limits; no software license fee.
watch_out: Requires your own OpenMeter services and dependencies such as Kafka, ClickHouse and PostgreSQL; infrastructure, payment processing and tax integrations cost extra. Managed Kong Konnect Metering & Billing is a separate paid offering; Helm chart is development-oriented.

name: Zoekt Open-Source Code Search
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source trigram code search engine with Git repository indexing, web interface, JSON and gRPC search APIs; no software subscription or per-query fee.
watch_out: Self-hosted indexing, storage, CPU/RAM, access control and server maintenance are your responsibility; infrastructure and any Git hosting costs are separate. No managed hosted free tier is included.

name: Livegrep Open-Source Code Search
free_limit: BSD-style open-source regex code search for large source repositories; self-hosted indexing backend and web UI with no software license or per-search fee.
watch_out: Requires Bazel build or your own container deployment, separate indexing/search processes, and self-managed CPU, RAM, storage and repository access; hosting costs are not included. This is not a managed hosted search tier.

name: Quartz Scheduler (Java OSS)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Java job-scheduling library; cron and calendar triggers, persistent jobs and clustering; no vendor per-job or per-project quota.
watch_out: Embedded in an application rather than a hosted scheduler; a database, worker runtime, servers and operations are supplied and paid for separately. Commercial use must comply with Apache-2.0 notices.

name: HookRun Webhook Action Engine
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook action engine; YAML routing, token/HMAC/IP checks, command and script execution, forwarding, retries and hot reload; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires an operator-managed server and TLS/reverse proxy. Webhook-triggered shell commands can be dangerous: validate signatures, restrict privileges and isolate scripts; hosting and network costs are separate.

name: Dapr Open Source Runtime
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-managed distributed-application runtime with service invocation, pub/sub, state management, jobs and durable workflows; no vendor software usage quota.
watch_out: Run Dapr sidecars and supporting components on infrastructure you operate. Kubernetes/VMs, message brokers, databases and managed cloud integrations can incur charges; this is not a vendor-hosted free compute tier.

name: Dramatiq Open Source Task Processing
free_limit: Free LGPL-licensed Python background task-processing library with RabbitMQ or Redis brokers, workers, retries and middleware; no vendor per-job software quota.
watch_out: You operate workers and a RabbitMQ/Redis broker; compute, storage and managed broker services may cost extra. LGPL license obligations apply to redistribution or modified library versions; commercial support is separate.

name: SOPS Open Source Secrets Encryption
free_limit: MPL-2.0 open-source local CLI encrypts YAML, JSON, ENV, INI and binary secrets using age, PGP or cloud KMS; no per-file software quota.
watch_out: Cloud KMS providers may charge for key operations; local age/PGP encryption avoids paid KMS. Safeguard private keys and plaintext, including CI logs and temporary files. MPL-2.0 redistribution obligations apply; SOPS does not provide hosted key management.

name: ProjectDiscovery Nuclei Open Source
free_limit: MIT-licensed local vulnerability scanner using community YAML templates for authorized HTTP, DNS, TCP, SSL and other security checks; no vendor software scan quota.
watch_out: Only scan assets you own or are explicitly authorized to assess. Treat third-party templates as untrusted checks; some may execute scripts or use headless browsers. Update the scanner/templates and throttle requests to avoid disruption. Hosted ProjectDiscovery services and CI compute are separate.

name: Google OSV-Scanner (Open Source)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source CLI scans project dependencies, lockfiles and container images against known OSV vulnerabilities; no vendor software seat or scan quota.
watch_out: Run locally or in your own CI; CI compute and storage may cost extra. Online scans query OSV.dev/deps.dev with dependency metadata; offline mode needs downloaded databases. Guided remediation can execute package-manager scripts.

name: Semgrep Community Edition
free_limit: Free LGPL-2.1 local static code analysis engine with community rules, 30+ supported languages, no account required for basic scans and no vendor software scan quota.
watch_out: Semgrep-maintained rules have separate rules-license restrictions on competing SaaS and some commercial redistribution; LGPL engine license differs from rule licenses. Pro engine, supply-chain and secrets detection, hosted management and CI resources may cost extra.

name: Tile38 Open-Source Geospatial Database
free_limit: MIT-licensed geospatial in-memory database server with real-time geofencing, spatial indexes, Redis RESP/HTTP interfaces and persistence; no vendor software quota or seat fee.
watch_out: Operate and secure your own Tile38 server, memory, storage and backups; infrastructure and networking costs are not included. Geofencing webhook destinations and external services may charge separately.

name: Longhorn Open-Source Kubernetes Block Storage
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes distributed block storage with persistent volumes, synchronous replication, snapshots and backups; no vendor software capacity quota.
watch_out: Requires a Kubernetes cluster and sufficient node disks, CPU, networking and backup targets; cloud disks and object-storage backup traffic may incur charges. Replica count increases physical storage consumption.

name: Grafana Pyroscope Open-Source Continuous Profiling
free_limit: Self-hosted AGPL-3.0 continuous profiling server for CPU, memory and application performance with profiling SDK/OTLP ingestion and Grafana visualization; no vendor software ingestion quota.
watch_out: Pyroscope 2.0 uses object storage for profiles; storage, compute, instrumentation and network traffic are user-provided and may cost extra. AGPL network-source obligations apply to modified versions; Grafana Cloud is a separately billed offering.

name: Microsoft ONNX Runtime Open-Source Inference Engine
free_limit: MIT-licensed cross-platform machine-learning inference runtime with CPU and supported hardware acceleration for ONNX models; no vendor software API quota or license seat fee.
watch_out: Run inference on your own devices or infrastructure; model weights, GPU/accelerator hardware, cloud compute and third-party services may cost extra. Some distribution builds collect usage telemetry; model licenses are separate.

name: Apache Tomcat Open Source
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Java web application server for Jakarta Servlet, Pages and WebSocket; no software-enforced app or request quota.
watch_out: Self-managed Java runtime, server, security updates and TLS setup required; infrastructure and third-party services are not free.

name: Nginx Proxy Manager
free_limit: MIT-licensed Docker reverse proxy manager with web UI, proxy hosts, redirections, access lists and Let's Encrypt TLS; no software-enforced traffic quota.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Docker host, domain/DNS and port access; infrastructure, bandwidth and optional DNS services cost extra; keep the admin interface protected.

name: Kilo Code Open Source Agent
free_limit: MIT-licensed AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains and CLI; locally installed extension and CLI have no software seat or usage quota.
watch_out: AI inference is not included: hosted model tokens, Kilo gateway and cloud agent may be billed; use a compatible locally hosted model to avoid model API fees. Agent can execute commands; review permissions.

name: OpenEBS Community Storage
free_limit: Open-source Kubernetes persistent volume provisioning for local and replicated storage; no software capacity or volume-count quota.
watch_out: Requires a managed or self-operated Kubernetes cluster and disks; storage, compute, backups and network transfer are not included. Replicated engines have node and kernel prerequisites.

name: Thanos Open Source Metrics
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Prometheus-compatible metrics querying, high availability and long-term retention; no software ingest or retention quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted components require Prometheus and compute; object storage, network egress and long-term retention incur infrastructure/provider costs.

name: Traefik Proxy Open Source
free_limit: MIT-licensed reverse proxy and ingress controller for Docker and Kubernetes; automatic service discovery, routing, TLS and load balancing without a software traffic quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted proxy requires compute, networking and DNS; infrastructure, certificate DNS providers and optional commercial support are not included. Secure exposed dashboards.

name: sqlite-vec Local Vector Search
free_limit: Free MIT/Apache-2.0 dual-licensed SQLite extension for local float, int8 and binary vector similarity search; no metered vendor service.
watch_out: Pre-v1 project; breaking API changes are possible. Requires a SQLite environment that permits loading extensions; local compute/storage and any external embedding APIs are not included.

name: Lunr.js Local Full-Text Search
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed full-text search library for browsers and Node.js; fielded search, fuzzy matching and language support with no hosted query quota.
watch_out: Client/server application must build and store its own search index; no hosted search infrastructure is included. Repository development is infrequent and large indexes use application memory.

name: Vince Self-Hosted Web Analytics

watch_out: Requires your own compute, storage, networking, and operations; object storage, Kubernetes, and external connector/provider charges are separate. Enterprise support and managed RisingWave Cloud are not included.

free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-managed API and AI gateway with dynamic routing, authentication, traffic management, and open-source plugins; no software license usage cap.
watch_out: Runs on your own infrastructure and uses NGINX and etcd; server, bandwidth, observability, and upstream API/LLM usage may incur costs. Paid vendor services or managed hosting are not included.

name: Atlantis Terraform PR Automation
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted automation for Terraform plan/apply workflows on pull requests; no software-imposed project, user, or run quota.
watch_out: Requires your own server, Git provider webhook integration, secure cloud credentials and infrastructure; Terraform providers and cloud resources can incur charges. No managed hosting or enterprise support is included.

name: Laf Open Source Serverless Platform
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-managed cloud-functions platform with database, object storage, WebIDE, web hosting and WebSocket support; no software license usage quota.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires your own Kubernetes, domain, TLS, compute, database and storage. Official deployment scripts are marked development-only and not production-ready; hosted Laf/Sealos usage is not included.

name: Redpanda Connect Community Connectors
free_limit: Self-managed stream-processing engine with free Community and Certified connectors under Apache-2.0 and MIT-licensed core; no stated free software execution quota.
watch_out: Enterprise connectors such as some CDC, Snowflake and Iceberg components require a paid license; paid support, managed Redpanda Cloud, compute, brokers, storage and third-party APIs are not included.

name: Watermill Go Event-Driven Library
free_limit: MIT-licensed Go library for pub/sub, event routers, middleware, HTTP webhook handling and message-driven applications; no software license usage quota.
watch_out: An embedded software library, not a hosted event delivery service. Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, databases, infrastructure and external API usage may cost money; deployment and reliability are your responsibility.

name: Vector Open-Source Observability Pipeline
free_limit: MPL-2.0 open-source Rust agent/aggregator to collect, transform and route logs and metrics using configurable sources, transforms and sinks; no software event or host quota.
watch_out: Self-operate the agent or aggregator and pay for any compute, network, buffering, log storage and paid telemetry destinations; metrics are beta in upstream docs and trace support is not generally available.

name: Lynis Open-Source Security Auditing
free_limit: GPLv3 open-source Unix/Linux/macOS security auditing and system-hardening CLI with local checks and recommendations; no software scan or host quota.
watch_out: The free local scanner does not include Lynis Enterprise dashboards, centralized reporting, commercial support or host infrastructure; audits require suitable system permissions and operator review.

name: osquery Open-Source Endpoint Visibility
free_limit: Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0 licensed SQL-based operating-system instrumentation and endpoint visibility for Linux, macOS and Windows; no software license fee or vendor-imposed query/endpoint quota.
watch_out: Run the agent and queries on your own endpoints; fleet management, centralized log storage, compute and commercial SaaS services are separate. Endpoint access and security permissions must be managed by the operator.

name: Prometheus Alertmanager Open Source
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted alert grouping, deduplication, routing, silencing and inhibition with webhook/email receiver integrations; no software alert or instance quota.
watch_out: Operate and secure your own Alertmanager instances and monitoring pipeline; Prometheus storage, servers, SMTP, SMS, PagerDuty and other third-party notification integrations may incur separate costs.

name: Vearch Open-Source Vector Search
free_limit: Apache-2.0 distributed vector database and similarity-search engine with standalone Docker Compose or Kubernetes self-hosting; no software-imposed query or vector quota.
watch_out: No vendor-hosted free storage or compute is included. Operate Docker/Kubernetes, disk, memory, replicas, backups and networking yourself; paid infrastructure and embedding/model services remain separate.

name: Infinity AI-Native Search Database (OSS)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source hybrid vector, sparse-vector, tensor and full-text search database; self-run Docker server or embedded Python engine without a software subscription.
watch_out: The free license does not provide hosted search, GPUs, compute, disk, backups or model inference. Docker/server mode requires operating your own infrastructure; embedded Python is a local option, not a vendor-hosted free cloud plan.

name: Static.so Starter Free Static Hosting
free_limit: Official $0/month Starter plan for static HTML/CSS/JS sites, with up to 100 MB of files per site and a hosted HTTPS static.so URL.
watch_out: Starter is advertised for personal projects; commercial eligibility and credit-card requirements are not stated clearly. Custom domains and Git deployments require paid Pro/Business. Monthly bandwidth quota is unpublished; sites may pause after exceeding it, and no overage charge occurs without consent.

name: FlagTGL Cloud Free
free_limit: Official $0/month hosted Free plan with 5 boolean feature flags, 1 project, 2 environments, 1,000 monthly active users and 2 seats.
watch_out: Paid Starter/Pro/Enterprise tiers offer separate 14-day trials, not part of this ongoing Free plan. Free excludes advanced flag types, streaming, segmentation and audit workflows; credit-card and commercial-use terms for Free are not explicitly confirmed. Exceeding the MAU/flag limits may require upgrading.

name: Apache OpenDAL Open-Source Storage Access SDK
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Rust storage access SDK and language bindings; free local integration with unified object, file, and cloud-storage APIs, without a hosted storage quota.
watch_out: OpenDAL is a software library, not free S3 buckets or cloud storage. S3/GCS/Azure and other backend providers may charge for stored data, requests, bandwidth, and infrastructure; follow Apache trademark and license terms.

name: Beekeeper Studio Community Edition
free_limit: GPLv3 Community Edition desktop SQL editor and database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite and other supported databases on Windows, macOS and Linux; free download and local use.
watch_out: Ultimate/Paid Edition features are under separate commercial terms; the repository includes commercially licensed code, so use only Community Edition's GPLv3 components. Database hosting and paid cloud connections are not included.

name: Lapce Open-Source Code Editor
free_limit: Apache-2.0 native Rust code editor with built-in LSP, modal editing, terminal, and WASI plugins; free local Windows, macOS and Linux builds with no software subscription.
watch_out: Remote development environments, cloud workspaces, external language services and infrastructure are separate and may incur charges; Lapce itself does not provide hosted compute or API credits.

name: OKD Community Kubernetes Application Platform
free_limit: Apache-2.0 OKD community Kubernetes/OpenShift upstream distribution with application deployment, scaling and cluster management; free software for self-managed clusters without a vendor subscription.
watch_out: OKD does not include free virtual machines, Kubernetes nodes, load balancers, storage, DNS, or enterprise support. Some bundled components have separate open-source licenses; operating and upgrading a cluster requires infrastructure and expertise.

name: Apache ECharts Open-Source Data Visualization
free_limit: Apache-2.0 browser-side JavaScript/TypeScript charting library for interactive charts and analytics visualizations; free for commercial applications with no chart or page-view license quota.
watch_out: ECharts is a local/browser visualization library, not a hosted analytics collection or reporting service. Data pipelines, databases, servers, paid map layers, hosting and third-party APIs are not included.

name: Metaflow Open-Source AI/ML Workflows
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Python workflow framework with local execution, experiment tracking, versioning, and workflow steps; no software subscription or execution-count cap for local runs.
watch_out: Cloud-scale execution on AWS, Azure, Kubernetes or other providers requires separately provisioned compute, object storage, orchestration and associated charges. This listing covers the free local framework, not managed cloud compute.

name: ClearML Open-Source MLOps
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-managed experiment tracking, data management, orchestration, scheduling and ML pipelines; the open-source server and SDK have no vendor-hosted free resource quota.
watch_out: You must operate your own server, storage, agents, GPU/CPU resources and dependencies; ClearML's separately hosted or enterprise services may have different pricing and feature limits.

name: Kubernetes ExternalDNS Controller (Open Source)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Kubernetes DNS automation controller that synchronizes Service and Ingress hostnames with supported DNS providers; no software subscription or per-record license charge.
watch_out: ExternalDNS is not a free authoritative DNS hosting service or CDN. A Kubernetes cluster, hosted zones, DNS provider API calls and cloud infrastructure can incur charges; use dry-run and ownership TXT records to prevent unwanted DNS changes.

name: Qwen Code Open-Source Local AI Coding Agent
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source terminal, editor and desktop AI coding agent; free to install and run locally with user-selected local models or external model providers.
watch_out: Free software does not mean free inference: hosted Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini APIs and cloud resources may require payment or billing setup. Do not rely on discontinued Qwen OAuth promotional free quotas; local model hardware and model licenses are separate.

name: AWS Chalice Open-Source Serverless Framework
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Python CLI and microframework for creating, testing and deploying AWS Lambda/API Gateway serverless applications; no software license fee or CLI usage cap.
watch_out: Chalice is free local developer software, NOT free AWS hosting. Deploying creates AWS Lambda, API Gateway and potentially S3/SQS/SNS resources with independent AWS quotas, billing and account requirements; card may be required by AWS. Review IAM permissions and service costs.

name: Cloudflare workerd Open-Source Workers Runtime
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source JavaScript/WebAssembly Workers runtime for running HTTP event-driven applications on your own server or VM; no workerd software license fee or runtime usage quota.
watch_out: This is the self-hosted runtime, NOT the managed Cloudflare Workers free tier or a complete hosted edge platform. You supply and pay for servers, orchestration, storage and networking; some managed Workers platform features are not included.

name: Zappa Open-Source Python Serverless Deployment
free_limit: MIT-licensed Python CLI for packaging and deploying Flask, Django and other Python web apps to AWS Lambda/API Gateway; no software license fee or CLI usage cap.
watch_out: Zappa itself runs locally and is free; AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch and other deployed resources may incur charges and require an AWS billing account/card. Default generated IAM execution policies can be broad; review least-privilege permissions before production.

name: Django-Flags Open Source
free_limit: CC0-1.0 Django feature-flag library; configurable flags in Django settings and admin, including user/date/URL conditions; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires Python 3.10+ and Django 4.2+; runs inside your own Django application and infrastructure. No hosted flag service or managed storage is included.

name: Django Waffle Open Source
free_limit: BSD-3-Clause Django feature-flag library with flags, switches and samples; no vendor software usage quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Django application, database and optional cache; no hosted feature-flag dashboard or infrastructure is included. Follow BSD notice and non-endorsement conditions.

name: just Open Source Command Runner
free_limit: CC0-1.0 local command runner for project-specific recipes in a justfile; no vendor software usage quota.
watch_out: Runs commands on your own machine or CI environment; not a hosted build or deployment service. Shells, tools, CI runners and external APIs used by recipes may have separate costs.

name: WRKFLW Open Source CI Workflow Runner
free_limit: MIT-licensed local CLI/TUI to validate and execute GitHub Actions workflows using Docker, Podman or emulation; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Not fully equivalent to GitHub-hosted runners: service containers and concurrency groups are unsupported; Windows/macOS runner emulation has limitations. Local container resources and optional remote secrets/cloud integrations are separate.

name: Apache Druid Open Source
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted real-time OLAP analytics database for streaming and batch ingestion, interactive SQL and dashboards; no software license or query quota.
watch_out: Operate your own Druid cluster, metadata database and deep storage; the official Docker quickstart needs at least 6 GiB memory and is not a production configuration. Compute, disks, Kafka/Kinesis and network usage are not included.

name: Polars Open Source DataFrame Engine
free_limit: MIT-licensed local DataFrame and query engine for Python, Rust and other supported bindings, with lazy and streaming processing; no software seat or data-volume quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own CPU, memory and storage. Polars Cloud and any remote compute or storage services are separate offerings with their own pricing; this listing covers only the open-source local library.

name: Apache DataFusion Open Source SQL Engine
free_limit: Apache-2.0 embeddable Rust SQL and DataFrame query engine for Arrow, CSV, Parquet, JSON and Avro data; no software seat or query quota.
watch_out: Runs in your own application or CLI on your own CPU, memory and storage; remote object stores and infrastructure may incur charges. Distributed Ballista is a separate project, not an included hosted free tier.

name: Apache Doris Open Source
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted SQL analytics and hybrid-search database with streaming ingestion, materialized views and lakehouse queries; no vendor software query quota.
watch_out: You supply compute, disks, networking, object storage, ingestion services and backups. Some third-party dependencies have incompatible licenses and features may need disabling for Apache-2.0 compliance; managed hosting is not included.

name: Fluentd Open Source Log Collector
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source log and event collection/routing with a plugin ecosystem; no Fluentd core license fee, per-node cap or vendor usage quota when self-operated.
watch_out: Operate and secure Fluentd agents/servers and log destinations yourself. Compute, storage, external SaaS outputs and commercial support can cost money; install current security fixes.

name: KICS Open Source IaC Security Scanner
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source CLI for scanning infrastructure-as-code templates and configuration files locally or in CI; no vendor-imposed license seat or scan quota for the OSS tool.
watch_out: The free KICS CLI is separate from paid Checkmarx products. Self-managed CI runners, cloud resources, third-party services and remediation work can cost money; findings need review.

name: OWASP Dependency-Check Open Source Scanner
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source software composition analysis CLI, build plugins and Docker scanner; no software license fee or per-project scan quota.
watch_out: Requires vulnerability data downloads and Java 11+. An NVD API key is strongly recommended due to rate limits; optional Sonatype OSS Index/Guide analyzers require credentials and may have separate commercial terms. CI runners and infrastructure cost extra.

name: Solid Queue (Rails)
free_limit: MIT-licensed database-backed Active Job queue for Rails: delayed and recurring jobs, concurrency controls, priorities, and bulk enqueuing; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Runs in your Rails application or workers; requires Rails 7.1+/Ruby 3.2+ and a supported SQL database (SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL). Application compute, database hosting, storage and operations are not free. Preserve MIT copyright and license notices.

name: GoodJob for Rails
free_limit: MIT-licensed PostgreSQL-backed Active Job queue for Rails: multithreaded jobs, scheduled/recurring jobs, priorities, retries, concurrency controls and dashboard; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Runs within your Rails process or separately managed workers and requires PostgreSQL; database, application hosting and operations can incur costs. Retain MIT copyright and license notices.

name: SmartDNS
free_limit: GPL-3.0-licensed local DNS resolver/server with upstream selection, DNS-over-HTTPS/TLS/QUIC and client filtering; no software query quota.
watch_out: You operate the DNS service on your router/server; compute, bandwidth and upstream DNS services may incur costs. GPL-3.0 redistribution and source-code obligations apply; this is not a hosted DNS/CDN free plan.

name: Bree Job Scheduler
free_limit: MIT-licensed Node.js job scheduler with worker threads, cron, date/interval scheduling, concurrency, graceful shutdown and optional retries; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Runs in your Node.js application/worker environment; persistence and job deduplication are application responsibilities, and any infrastructure or external database costs are separate. Retain MIT notices.

name: Agenda 6 Open Source Job Scheduler
free_limit: MIT-licensed Node.js 18+ TypeScript/ESM job scheduler with cron and human-readable schedules, concurrency/locking, and pluggable MongoDB, PostgreSQL or Redis backends; no software job quota.
watch_out: You must provide and operate a database and Node.js process; managed database/compute costs are separate. Agenda 6 requires ESM and a separately installed backend package; migrations from v5 have breaking changes.

name: Styx Open Source AI Agent Workspace
free_limit: Apache-2.0 local desktop workspace for multiple coding agents, isolated task branches, approval gates, project management and scoped deployment credentials; free software on macOS, Windows and Linux.
watch_out: Windows/Linux support is beta; separate Claude, Codex, Gemini or other agent subscriptions, API calls, cloud resources and deployment accounts may incur charges. Free desktop software does not include paid agent/model access.

name: HexClaw Desktop Open Source
free_limit: Apache-2.0 desktop AI-agent workspace for macOS, Windows and Linux; local Go sidecar, multi-model chat, knowledge base, tools and task automation; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Online LLM/API providers may charge separately; local Ollama models require device resources. Windows/Linux need separately installed Ollama for local models; pre-release builds and platform dependencies vary. Desktop software is free, not a free hosted inference tier.

name: HookBus Light Open Source Agent Event Bus
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted event bus for AI-agent lifecycle events, HTTP webhook publishers, event fan-out, subscriber verdicts and audit routing; no software metered quota.
watch_out: Developer preview/reference implementation, not a production security perimeter. Requires own Docker/server, TLS, token management and optional publisher/subscriber components; review SECURITY.md before sensitive use. Hosting and integrations may cost money.

name: Hugging Face smolagents Open Source
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Python library for code-based and tool-calling AI agents, local agent orchestration, model adapters and sandbox integrations; no software usage quota.
watch_out: Model inference, hosted endpoints, E2B/Modal/Blaxel sandboxes and compute may charge separately. Code execution requires careful sandboxing and security review; the free library does not include free hosted LLM tokens.

name: Bazel Open Source Build System
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source local build and test automation for multi-language projects, with incremental builds, dependency analysis and caching; no vendor-imposed build-minute or seat quota for the local tool.
watch_out: Runs on your own machines or CI runners; hosted runners, remote caching/execution, artifact storage and compute can incur charges. Bazel installers can bundle third-party binaries with separate license terms (including GPLv2 with Classpath exception); review redistributed dependencies.

name: Pants Open Source Build System
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source local build, test, lint and package automation for monorepos and supported languages; no software seat, project or execution-minute quota.
watch_out: Pants runs on user-provided machines or CI runners; remote caches, external services and infrastructure are not included. Language/tool integrations and compatibility depend on the installed version and selected backends.

name: LlamaIndex Open Source Framework
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source Python framework for document ingestion, retrieval-augmented generation, data indexing and agent workflows, usable locally without a software seat or project quota.
watch_out: The framework does not include free hosted LLM inference, embedding APIs, vector databases or cloud infrastructure; selected model providers and LlamaCloud hosted services can bill separately. Configure local models and storage for an entirely self-operated setup.

name: Perses Open Source Observability Dashboards
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source observability dashboard server, CLI and dashboard-as-code tools supporting Prometheus, Tempo, Loki and Pyroscope; no software seat or dashboard quota.
watch_out: Self-host and operate Perses on your own compute; data sources, metrics/log storage, network and infrastructure are not included. Managed support or hosted observability services may charge separately.

name: Prowler Open Source CLI
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source command-line cloud security and compliance scanner for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Microsoft 365 and GitHub; no Prowler OSS seat or scan quota.
watch_out: Requires your own machine and authorized cloud credentials. Provider API usage, log/storage and cloud resources can incur charges; Prowler Cloud managed platform and support are separate paid offerings. Review IAM permissions and scan impact.

name: Ibis Open Source DataFrame Framework
free_limit: Apache-2.0 portable Python dataframe and analytics expression library supporting local DuckDB and 20+ SQL/compute backends; no software seat, query or project quota.
watch_out: Ibis is a client-side framework, not free hosted analytics compute. Cloud warehouses, external database engines, data transfer and query execution may be billed separately; install appropriate backend dependencies.

name: Kubescape Open Source Kubernetes Security CLI
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes security CLI for scanning cluster configurations, YAML manifests, Helm charts and container images against compliance and vulnerability controls; no software seat or scan quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own workstation or CI and requires appropriate cluster access for live scans. Kubernetes compute, image registries and security feeds can incur separate costs; ARMO hosted services/support are not included. Use fix/patch commands only after review.

name: ProjectDiscovery dnsx DNS Toolkit
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source local DNS query and discovery CLI supporting A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT records, wildcard filtering, custom resolvers and bulk hostname resolution; no software seat or query quota.
watch_out: This is a DNS client and discovery utility, not free authoritative DNS hosting. Network traffic, upstream resolver rate limits and infrastructure costs remain your responsibility; only probe domains you are authorized to test.

name: Gokapi Self-Hosted File Sharing
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted file-sharing server with expiring download links, optional end-to-end encryption and local or S3-compatible storage; no software-imposed transfer quota.
watch_out: Provide and secure your own server, disk, TLS and bandwidth; optional S3 storage/requests may be billed. Shared files can expire by configured time/download limits; AGPL-3.0 obligations apply to modified network deployments.
